sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选访谈，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hey there, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: This week, The Daily is revisiting some of our favorite episodes of the year, listening back, and then hearing what's happened in the time since.
sentences.zh: 本周，《每日新闻》将回顾我们今年最喜欢的一些单集，重温它们，然后了解此后发生的事情。

sentences.en: Today, The Whistleblowers at Boeing.
sentences.zh: 今天，波音公司的吹哨人。

sentences.en: It's Friday, January 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是 1 月 3 日，星期五。

sentences.en: You know, I'd walk into the store around here and they're like, oh, you work for Boeing?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我走进这里的商店时，他们会说，哦，你在波音工作？

sentences.en: That is awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And thank y'all so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们大家。

sentences.en: And you just mean so much to this area, you know.
sentences.zh: 你们对这个地区意义重大，你知道的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And it was just awesome doing Boeing.
sentences.zh: 在波音工作真是太棒了。

sentences.en: Did you ever expect to feel the way that you feel about the company now?
sentences.zh: 你有没有想过自己现在对这家公司的感觉会是这样？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对没有。

sentences.en: Natalie, I'd still lose or something.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，我还是会输或者别的什么。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But, but I just, you know, I had to get it.
sentences.zh: 但是，但是我知道，我必须把它弄好。

sentences.en: I have to get it.
sentences.zh: 我必须弄好它。

sentences.en: Somebody's got to step in.
sentences.zh: 总得有人介入。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Indonesia's search and rescue agency says that a Lion Air passenger flight has crashed into the sea.
sentences.zh: 印度尼西亚搜救机构表示，一架狮航载客航班坠入海中。

sentences.en: An Ethiopian Airlines Boeing 737 traveling from Addis Ababa to Nairobi has crashed with deaths reported.
sentences.zh: 一架从亚的斯亚贝巴飞往内罗毕的埃塞俄比亚航空波音 737 客机坠毁，据报有人员伤亡。

sentences.en: After the two crashes of Boeing's 737 MAX jets, regulators and lawmakers began asking
sentences.zh: 在波音 737 MAX 客机发生两起坠机事故后，监管机构和议员开始质疑

sentences.en: questions about whether the race to get that jet built and the competitive pressure may have led
sentences.zh: 赶造该客机的竞赛以及竞争压力是否导致了

sentences.en: Boeing to miss safety risks in the plane's design.
sentences.zh: 波音忽视了飞机设计中的安全风险。

sentences.en: The FAA and Boeing say faulty sensors on new 737 MAX jets can cause the plane to go into a steep dive.
sentences.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）和波音公司表示，新款 737 MAX 客机上的传感器故障会导致飞机急剧俯冲。

sentences.en: In reporting that story, my colleague Natalie Kichowa began to look into whether that pressure extends beyond the 737 MAX.
sentences.zh: 在报道这一事件时，我的同事娜塔莉·基乔瓦开始调查这种压力是否超出了 737 MAX 的范围。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, April 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是 4 月 23 日，星期二。

sentences.en: Natalie, where does this story start?
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，这个故事从哪里开始？

sentences.en: In the wake of the two crashes of the 737 MAX jet, we began looking into whether that frenzied pace,
sentences.zh: 在 737 MAX 客机发生两起坠机事故之后，我们开始调查这种疯狂的节奏，

sentences.en: whether those pressures might have had an impact not just on the engineering decisions around the
sentences.zh: 这些压力是否不仅对最高层有关该飞机设计的工程决策产生了影响，

sentences.en: design of the aircraft at the highest levels, but whether it also plays out on the factory floor and affects the people who are actually building Boeing planes.
sentences.zh: 而且是否也在工厂车间上演，并影响了实际建造波音飞机的人们。

sentences.en: Basically, is there a larger cultural issue here?
sentences.zh: 基本上，这里是否存在更广泛的文化问题？

sentences.en: That's the question we were asking.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们当时提出的问题。

sentences.en: Then we hear from attorneys who are representing multiple whistleblowers who work on the factory floor at Boeing.
sentences.zh: 然后我们听取了代表波音工厂车间多名吹哨人的律师的意见。

sentences.en: And it turns out that these whistleblowers have been trying to get attention to these issues, to their concerns, for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这些吹哨人很长一段时间以来一直试图让人们关注这些问题、他们的担忧。

sentences.en: And any time you hear about there being several whistleblowers with the same concerns at a company like
sentences.zh: 每当你听说像波音这样的公司有几个吹哨人抱有同样的担忧时，

sentences.en: Boeing, you pay attention.
sentences.zh: 你就会密切关注。

sentences.en: So, one of these whistleblowers was named John.
sentences.zh: 所以，其中一位吹哨人的名字叫约翰。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: Hey, Swampy.
sentences.zh: 嗨，斯旺皮。

sentences.en: Hey, how you doing, Natalie?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好吗，娜塔莉？

sentences.en: Or Swampy.
sentences.zh: 或者叫斯旺皮。

sentences.en: Swampy.
sentences.zh: 斯旺皮。

sentences.en: He goes by Swampy.
sentences.zh: 他大家都叫他斯旺皮。

sentences.en: It's short for Swamp Dog.
sentences.zh: 这是沼泽狗（Swamp Dog）的简称。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm going to have the other one.
sentences.zh: 对，我要拿另一个。

sentences.en: So, I start talking to Swampy.
sentences.zh: 于是，我开始和斯旺皮交谈。

sentences.en: Can I ask why you decided to become a whistleblower?
sentences.zh: 我能问问你为什么决定成为一名吹哨人吗？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And that leads me to many other whistleblowers.
sentences.zh: 这让我接触到了许多其他的吹哨人。

sentences.en: We're not talking about cars.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的不是汽车。

sentences.en: You know, if your car breaks down, you can pull over to the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你的汽车抛锚了，你可以把车停在路边。

sentences.en: There is no pulling over.
sentences.zh: 飞机是没有办法停在路边的。

sentences.en: And ultimately...
sentences.zh: 归根结底……

sentences.en: And there's other things about the plane, the actual material that it's made.
sentences.zh: 关于飞机还有其他事情，比如制造它的实际材料。

sentences.en: My colleague and I talk to more than a dozen current and former employees.
sentences.zh: 我和我的同事采访了十多名现任和前任员工。

sentences.en: And we review hundreds of pages of internal emails, company documents, federal records.
sentences.zh: 我们查阅了数百页的内部电子邮件、公司文件和联邦记录。

sentences.en: We speak with the FAA and with Boeing.
sentences.zh: 我们与美国联邦航空管理局和波音公司进行了交谈。

sentences.en: And we begin to piece together an entirely new narrative about the way that manufacturing is done at Boeing that we never expected to find.
sentences.zh: 我们开始拼凑出一个关于波音制造方式的全新故事，这是我们从未料到的。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, your 787 Dreamliner.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，您的 787 梦想客机。

sentences.en: So, it starts with the 787 Dreamliner, another of Boeing's crown jewels.
sentences.zh: 所以，这一切始于 787 梦想客机，这是波音公司的另一颗明珠。

sentences.en: This is the first commercial airplane to be made with 50% composite materials.
sentences.zh: 这是第一架采用 50% 复合材料制造的商用飞机。

sentences.en: It was unveiled in 2007, and it was Boeing's most important offering in a generation.
sentences.zh: 它于 2007 年亮相，是波音一代人中最最重要的产品。

sentences.en: And it looks cool.
sentences.zh: 而且它看起来很酷。

sentences.en: I remember reading about this plane that said giant windows, the kind of unusually big nose.
sentences.zh: 我记得读到过关于这架飞机的报道，说它有巨大的窗户，有着不寻常的大机头。

sentences.en: It was going to be the next big thing in airlines.
sentences.zh: 它将成为航空公司的下一个重大突破。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Oh, that was the news of the month.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是当月的新闻。

sentences.en: New airplane, new technology, you know, state of the art.
sentences.zh: 新飞机，新技术，你知道的，最先进的。

sentences.en: And for a while it was.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间确实如此。

sentences.en: That was our future.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的未来。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: That's why it's the Dreamliner, because it's our future, you know.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它被称为梦想客机，因为它是我们的未来，你知道的。

sentences.en: Fully composite, you know, carbon fiber reinforced.
sentences.zh: 全复合材料，你知道的，碳纤维增强材料。

sentences.en: It was a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事。

sentences.en: The fortunes of the Boeing company are flying on the wings of the Dreamliner.
sentences.zh: 波音公司的命运正飞翔在梦想客机的翅膀上。

sentences.en: So, any word of a delay is not going to be well-received on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 因此，任何关于延误的消息都不会受到华尔街的好评。

sentences.en: But pretty quickly, the 787 program begins to run into probleMs.
sentences.zh: 但很快，787 项目开始遇到问题。

sentences.en: So, it is delaying this.
sentences.zh: 所以，它正在推迟。

sentences.en: And Boeing's saying, in fact, it's not going to know, even for the next few weeks, when it is going to reschedule.
sentences.zh: 波音公司表示，事实上，甚至在接下来的几周内，它都不知道何时会重新安排时间。

sentences.en: Well, now the company is dealing with two new 787 incidents in the past two days.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在该公司正在处理过去两天发生的两起新的 787 事件。

sentences.en: Yet another delay for Boeing's 787 Dreamliner.
sentences.zh: 波音 787 梦想客机又一次延误。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 这家美国

sentences.en: plane maker pushed back the schedule for the fourth time.
sentences.zh: 飞机制造商第四次推迟了时间表。

sentences.en: To the point where Boeing begins to get a bit concerned about whether it's going to meet the deadlines that it's set for the program.
sentences.zh: 以至于波音开始有点担心它是否能达到为该项目设定的截止日期。

sentences.en: Elsewhere, a confident Boeing is going to build a second plan to make its 787 Dreamliner.
sentences.zh: 在其他地方，自信的波音将建造第二座工厂来制造其 787 梦想客机。

sentences.en: So, Boeing decides it's going to open a brand new factory.
sentences.zh: 于是，波音决定开设一家全新的工厂。

sentences.en: And how big a deal is that for Boeing?
sentences.zh: 这对波音来说有多重要？

sentences.en: This is a huge deal for Boeing.
sentences.zh: 这对波音来说是一件大事。

sentences.en: Boeing has been making its commercial aircraft in two factories in Washington.
sentences.zh: 波音一直在华盛顿的两家工厂制造其商用飞机。

sentences.en: This would be a foray into a new state, a new assembly line.
sentences.zh: 这将是进军一个新州、一条新总装线。

sentences.en: You're talking a manufacturing hub that needs to be state-of-the-art, that can manufacture one of the most advanced aircraft in the world.
sentences.zh: 你在谈论一个需要最先进的制造中心，能够制造世界上最先进的飞机之一。

sentences.en: A major investment, both in real estate and in jobs.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔重大投资，无论是在房地产还是在就业方面。

sentences.en: And where do they end up building the facility?
sentences.zh: 他们最终把工厂建在哪里了？

sentences.en: Do I even need to say it is a great day in South Carolina?
sentences.zh: 我甚至需要说南卡罗来纳州今天是个好日子吗？

sentences.en: They pick Charleston, South Carolina.
sentences.zh: 他们选择了南卡罗来纳州的查尔斯顿。

sentences.en: We are telling the entire world that we build things in South Carolina.
sentences.zh: 我们正在向全世界宣告，我们在南卡罗来纳州制造东西。

sentences.en: We build cars, we build tires, and now we build dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 我们制造汽车，我们制造轮胎，现在我们制造梦想。

sentences.en: Big Mac Daddy, 787 dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 大老爹，787 的梦想。

sentences.en: The issue is that Boeing has promised to create 3,800 local jobs.
sentences.zh: 问题是波音承诺创造 3800 个本地就业机会。

sentences.en: But Charleston doesn't have the thriving aerospace workforce that you would see in Washington, where Boeing has nurtured generations of aircraft builders.
sentences.zh: 但查尔斯顿并没有你在华盛顿能看到的繁荣的航空航天劳动力，波音在那里培育了几代飞机制造者。

sentences.en: And they bring people like Swampy, managers from the Washington area, over to Charleston to get things started.
sentences.zh: 他们把像斯旺皮这样的人、华盛顿地区的经理带到查尔斯顿来开展工作。

sentences.en: I'm originally from Louisiana, Boeing, South Carolina, so I want to be a part of that, you know?
sentences.zh: 我原本来自路易斯安那州，波音南卡罗来纳州，所以我想成为其中的一部分，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Was the culture of the factory in Charleston the same as the culture of the factory in Washington?
sentences.zh: 查尔斯顿工厂的文化和华盛顿工厂的文化一样吗？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对不一样。

sentences.en: A lot of people really had no experience with building airplanes and building commercial airplanes and understanding the reality of them.
sentences.zh: 很多人确实没有制造飞机、制造商用飞机以及了解其现实情况的经验。

sentences.en: So, you know, that was the big change.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，那是巨大的改变。

sentences.en: So, they are furiously trying to train all of these new workers, but they're really far behind on the 787 program, years behind.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们拼命地试图培训所有这些新工人，但他们在 787 项目上落后了很多，落后了好几年。

sentences.en: Eventually, the plane comes out, but a couple years later, they run into a problem.
sentences.zh: 最终，飞机问世了，但几年后，他们遇到了问题。

sentences.en: The FAA suddenly announced they are grounding the Dreamliner.
sentences.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局突然宣布将梦想客机停飞。

sentences.en: The FAA grounds the fleet after a problem with batteries overheating that could cause a fire.
sentences.zh: 在发生电池过热可能引发火灾的问题后，美国联邦航空管理局下令停飞该机队。

sentences.en: It's grounded until it can prove to the federal government that the airline has fixed the problem with the battery that continues to overheat.
sentences.zh: 在向联邦政府证明航空公司已经解决了持续过热的电池问题之前，飞机将一直停飞。

sentences.en: They come up with a fix.
sentences.zh: 他们拿出了一个解决方案。

sentences.en: But what I am learning from people like Swampy, from the more than a dozen current and former employees that we talk to, is that the batteries weren't the only problem.
sentences.zh: 但我从像斯旺皮这样的人、我们采访的十多名现任和前任员工那里了解到的是，电池并不是唯一的问题。

sentences.en: That there was pressure on the factory floor that was creating a litany of other issues.
sentences.zh: 工厂车间存在的压力引发了一系列其他问题。

sentences.en: What was your title when you moved to Charleston?
sentences.zh: 你搬到查尔斯顿时的头衔是什么？

sentences.en: Family quality manager.
sentences.zh: 工厂质量经理。

sentences.en: So, as a quality control manager, part of Swampy's job was to check the insides of planes to make sure that as workers are building the planes, nothing is left behind.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为一名质量控制经理，斯旺皮的工作之一就是检查飞机的内部，确保工人在制造飞机时没有遗留任何东西。

sentences.en: No debris is left inside the aircraft.
sentences.zh: 飞机内部没有留下任何碎片。

sentences.en: So I was called out to the airplane to look at titanium slivers laying around.
sentences.zh: 所以我被叫到飞机上去看周围散落的钛合金碎屑。

sentences.en: And while he's doing these inspections, he begins to notice that there are clusters of metal slivers that are hanging over the wires that control the plane.
sentences.zh: 在他进行这些检查时，他开始注意到控制飞机的电线上挂着一簇簇金属碎屑。

sentences.en: Any kind of power, any kind of electronic equipment, and short it out and cause a fire.
sentences.zh: 任何类型的电源、任何类型的电子设备，都可能使其短路并引起火灾。

sentences.en: And if it's at 40,000 feet, that's a problem.
sentences.zh: 如果在 4 万英尺的高空，这绝对是个问题。

sentences.en: Is this normal?
sentences.zh: 这正常吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不正常。

sentences.en: This is a firSt.
sentences.zh: 这是破天荒第一次。

sentences.en: And so he brings the issue to his managers, and he says, we need to clean this.
sentences.zh: 于是他把这个问题带给他的经理，他说，我们需要清理这个。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I physically showed him the airplane.
sentences.zh: 我亲自带他看了飞机。

sentences.en: I took pictures, sent him pictures,
sentences.zh: 我拍了照片，把照片发给了他，

sentences.en: and a peer of mine walked in on,
sentences.zh: 我的一个同事走进来，

sentences.en: you need to go inspect line 230.
sentences.zh: 你需要去检查 230 号生产线。

sentences.en: I said, that's what we just looked at.
sentences.zh: 我说，这就是我们刚刚看过的。

sentences.en: These are the pictures I sent you.
sentences.zh: 这些就是我发给你的照片。

sentences.en: I said, I won't sign off on it.
sentences.zh: 我说，我不会签字认可的。

sentences.en: I won't accept it.
sentences.zh: 我不会接受的。

sentences.en: So he, I was removed from it.
sentences.zh: 所以他，我被调离了那个岗位。

sentences.en: So you're saying you alerted your manager to the debris that you found on this plane, and in response, he took you off the plane and gave it to someone else to inspect.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，你向经理报告了在这架飞机上发现的碎片，作为回应，他把你调离了这架飞机，并让其他人去检查。

sentences.en: Did that ever get cleaned?
